title: Spook the Machine: Gamified Exploration of Human Imagination of Machine Fear
abstract: arXiv:2609.15472v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: What happens when AI machines express fear? Do humans engage differently depending on how they express it? And what does it take to design for affective human-AI interaction? We present Spook the Machine, a gamified platform where participants generate images to frighten AI agents endowed with personality-driven phobias. Machines respond with emotional reactions ranging from calm analysis to begging for mercy, and a gallery of successful scares becomes visible to subsequent users. In a public deployment during Halloween 2024, 832 participants created 15,719 artifacts across 89 machines in a $2\times2$ design varying the machine's emotional expressiveness (neutral vs. high-emotion) and reward structure (rewarding scariness alone vs. scariness plus novelty). translated_title: 吓机一跳：游戏化探索人类对机器恐惧的想象
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.15472v1 公告类型：交叉  摘要：当AI机器表达恐惧时会发生什么？人类是否会根据机器表达恐惧的方式而产生不同的互动？设计情感化的人机交互又需要什么？我们提出了“Spook the Machine”（吓机一跳），一个游戏化平台，参与者可以在平台上生成图像来惊吓被赋予个性化恐惧症的AI智能体。机器会做出从冷静分析到乞求饶命等各种情绪反应，成功惊吓的作品画廊对后续用户可见。在2024年万圣节期间的公开部署中，832名参与者在89台机器上创建了15,719件作品，实验采用2×2设计，变化机器的情绪表现力（中性 vs. 高情绪）和奖励结构（仅奖励惊吓程度 vs. 奖励惊吓程度加新颖性）。结果表明，情绪表现丰富的机器在失败时刻加深了用户参与度：即使机器没有表达恐惧，用户也会花更长时间思考，并且能从画廊中更快地学习……
tldr: 本文提出了游戏化平台“Spook the Machine”，让用户生成图像惊吓具有个性化恐惧症的AI智能体，并通过832名参与者、15,719件作品的大规模部署实验发现，情绪表现丰富的机器即使在失败时刻也能加深用户参与，为情感化人机交互设计提供了新见解。
en_tdlr: We present "Spook the Machine," a gamified platform where users generate images to scare AI agents with personality-driven phobias, showing through a large-scale deployment (832 participants, 15,719 artifacts) that emotionally expressive machines deepen user engagement even at moments of failure.
